<h1>Md Bodrud-Doza</h1>
<p class="appointment">PhD in Geography · Postdoctoral Scholar</p>
<p class="affiliation"><a href="https://geg.uoguelph.ca/">Department of Geography, Environment and Geomatics</a><br><a href="https://www.uoguelph.ca/">University of Guelph</a>, Canada</p>
<p class="hero-intro">I study how agricultural landscapes can sustain food production while protecting water, soil, and ecosystems.</p>
<p>I bring together geospatial analysis, environmental monitoring, machine learning, and process-based modelling to understand environmental risks and support better landscape-management decisions.</p>

## Current research directions

<p class="program-intro"><a href="research.qmd"><strong>REAL Decision Lab</strong></a> · Developing research program</p>

<div class="cards three"><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Established foundation</p><h3>Precision & multifunctional conservation</h3><p>Target conservation where it can deliver water-quality and wider landscape benefits.</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Emerging methods</p><h3>Earth observation & GeoAI</h3><p>Use Earth observation and GeoAI (AI for geographic data) to understand agricultural and environmental change.</p></article><article class="research-card"><p class="eyebrow">Developing direction</p><h3>Food-system resilience</h3><p>Explore how early stress signals and capacities to absorb shocks can inform timely adaptation.</p></article></div>
